items.title: Tech sell-off resumes as Nvidia shares drop 5% and Anthropic tumbles below IPO price
items.take: Monday's relief rally is already being sold: Nvidia gives back a chunk of its 31.5% surge in premarket, and Anthropic slipped below its $83 IPO price just three days after its record Nasdaq debut. The market is treating Monday's bounce as the trade that survived, not proof the AI unwind is over.

items.title: Nvidia's Huang returns to cheers in China, but political hurdles mount
items.take: Huang was gone only eleven days after revelations including an affair with a businesswoman alleged to be a Beijing spy, and returns to a far more restrictive US-China tech environment than he left. Trump says he personally convinced the board to bring him back, a remarkable flex over a four-trillion-dollar company.

items.title: Sanofi strikes $41 billion deal to acquire US drugmaker Insmed
items.take: Sanofi pays $175 a share in cash, its biggest deal in two decades and the second mega-deal this week after CrowdStrike-Zscaler. Insmed jumped 14% premarket, and Sanofi calls the respiratory portfolio a $10 billion peak-sales play beyond Dupixent.

items.title: December Fed hike stays in play as Williams says Fed must act
items.take: NY Fed president John Williams said the Fed must keep acting on inflation, and markets price a December hike as near-certain with about 5% odds of a half-point move. Wednesday's PCE report, with core seen rising to 3.2%, is the last major data before the December 9 decision.

items.title: Retail earnings jump premarket before Thanksgiving: DICK'S, Kohl's, Dollar Tree
items.take: DICK'S surged 16% premarket on a raised outlook and Kohl's added 7% on returning to sales growth, a strong start to the holiday shopping read. Dollar Tree beat on earnings but cut its profit outlook, and Best Buy reports before the open.
